svg.text: Reference boards, build step W3: palettes (proposals)

Dune isle, Palm coast, Fern jungle, Reed marsh, Ash woods, Steam springs, Snow taiga, Frost peaks, Storm cliffs. Every colour is a proposal for the designer to review; text and sources in reference-boards-w3.md.
Bar: rough share of the screen (the camera shows ground and the tops of things). S = HSV saturation. Discs: the red, yellow, blue, green and uncoloured warnings as the game blends them today.
Today: warnings on the M1 greybox ground

Warnings on this ground (main, lightest, darkest)
